meta.title: Grafish — a graphic design studio in your browser
meta.description: Image effects, posters, fonts, patterns, shapes, and 3D in one lightweight studio.

home.lede: A print studio in the browser. Image effects that aren't generic, a font library of its own, patterns, shapes, and 3D you can bake into 2D effects, all on one canvas.

studio.exportSoon: Export becomes available when the Effects lab opens.

effects.name: Effects
effects.blurb: Halftone, dither, stipple, ASCII, glitch, and more on your images.

poster.name: Poster
poster.blurb: Artboards, layers, type, and per-layer effects.

type.name: Type
type.blurb: Font library, tester, waterfall, glyphs, and text effects.

3d.name: 3D
3d.blurb: Real 3D models on the canvas, baked for 2D effects.

play.name: Play
play.blurb: Tic-tac-toe skinned with your patterns and fonts.
